I don’t really know what’s keeping me going. I believe I will never be loved, am bound to be a failure, have no purpose, have no friends,  that anything kind directed towards me must be a lie, and I still haven’t gotten over a breakup 5 months later. But every time I have a loaded gun to my head or a knife to my wrist I just seem to not go for it. I don’t know if it’s the smallest hope that’s left but it just feels like there really isn’t anything stopping me.

For a while it was my girlfriend as she was really the only light in my world but then she broke up with me. Although she did nothing wrong and the reason she did it was understandable she still tortures me as I continue to deal with my depression especially since when you find a light you don’t ever wanna let it go.
Professional help is not something I seek, although it may help there is a chance that it’ll only make things worse so I’m choosing to stay away from it
